scope: Read-only audit of the active development connection and primary 007 recovery service before deployment

root.initial_query_note: An earlier read-only query failed without a retained detailed cause; the subsequent query succeeded. Credential expiry was not inferred from the first failure.

hello_metadata_review.account_selection: implicit saved-account path overwrites allow with one saved credential principal
hello_metadata_review.hello: Options.metadata clones allow; register_ssh serializes the resulting Hello
hello_metadata_review.relay: forwards parsed Frame unchanged to the authenticated WebSocket
hello_metadata_review.candidate_server_acceptance_of_existing_: source-incompatible legacy @github allow entry; no reconnect experiment performed
hello_metadata_review.source_inference_basis: The live process reports v0.10.12 and uses implicit saved-account startup; the corresponding official source validates the saved principal and forwards it in Hello.allow.

recovery007.source: direct saved-account connection; Hello metadata.allow is empty

conclusion.suggested_release_order: Resolve or explicitly migrate affected legacy ordinary-client handshakes before CD, preserve the independently verified 007 recovery path, and verify post-deployment reconnection before declaring deployment ready.
conclusion.deployment_blocker: The ordinary v0.10.12/v0.10.13 account client sends a saved GitHub principal in Hello.allow; the v0.10.14 strict registered-account allow list does not accept that legacy syntax. The primary 007 path sends an empty allow list, but whoami success alone does not validate old ordinary-client reconnection.
